definitions.explanation: An award given in competitions and contests to works that are commendable but did not win the top prizes.
A work of art, literature, or other creative endeavor that is well-crafted and praiseworthy.

examples.japanese: {佳作|かさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: It was selected for honorable mention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{佳作|かさく}⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Five honorable mentions were announced from among the submitted works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃|のが}した→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{佳作|かさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧た⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I missed the grand prize this time, but I'm happy just to have received an honorable mention.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{佳作|かさく}だ。
examples.english: This film is a fine piece of work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{佳作|かさく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}べる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many novels that are unassuming but can be called fine works.
Among his early works, there are several fine pieces.

notes:
A compound of {佳|か} (good/beautiful) and ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work/creation). Has two distinct uses: as a competition award rank (below grand prize and runner-up) and as a general compliment for well-made creative works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {佳作|かさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be selected for honorable mention
- {佳作|かさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to receive an honorable mention
- {佳作|かさく}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: honorable mention award
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{佳作|かさく}: a hidden gem

USAGE:
In competitions, the typical award hierarchy is ⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧ (grand prize) → {優秀賞|ゆうしゅうしょう} (excellence award) → {佳作|かさく} (honorable mention). When used to describe a work outside of competitions, {佳作|かさく} implies solid quality without being a masterpiece.
